_: Third-party pi packages staged to be replaced by suite components (docs/plugins.md, 'Staged migration'). Never deployed: lib/pi_suite_migration.py reads it and rewrites settings.managed.json; the merge itself ignores it. `suite` is the pinned package; each entry maps a `packages` source to the suite component (packages/<name>) that replaces it. Nothing moves until the pinned suite revision provides the component.
